question: In which of the following states is the Bokaro Steel Plant located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bokaro Steel Plant** is located in the state of **Jharkhand**, India. It is one of the largest steel plants in the country and is managed by the **Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL)**.
 
• The plant was established with the assistance of the **former Soviet Union**. It commenced operations in **1972** and has since played a significant role in India's steel production capacity.
 
• **Bokaro** is known as the “**Steel City of India**” due to the presence of this significant plant and its contribution to India's industrial growth.
 
• The plant produces various types of steel products, including **hot-rolled, cold-rolled, galvanized sheets, and plates**, which are utilized in construction, automotive, and other industrial sectors.
 
• Initially part of Bihar, **Bokaro** became part of Jharkhand when the state was carved out of Bihar on **15 November 2000**. This reorganization aimed to address regional demands for better governance and economic development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL):**

 
 
• SAIL is one of the largest state-owned steel-making companies in India.
 
• It operates and manages five integrated steel plants, including the Bokaro Steel Plant, and three special steel plants across India.
 
• SAIL was established in **1954** and has played a key role in India's industrial development.
 
 
 
• **Other Major Steel Plants in India:**
 
 
• **Bhilai Steel Plant:** Located in **Chhattisgarh**, it is another major steel plant under SAIL and specializes in producing rails and plates.
 
• **Rourkela Steel Plant:** Situated in **Odisha**, it is the first integrated steel plant in the public sector in India.
 
• **Durgapur Steel Plant:** Located in **West Bengal**, this plant primarily produces structural steel for the construction and infrastructure sectors.
 
• **Jamshedpur Steel Plant:** Operated by Tata Steel, it is located in **Jharkhand** and is one of the oldest steel plants in India.
 
 
 
• **Economic Importance of Bokaro Steel Plant:**
 
 
• The Bokaro Steel Plant contributes significantly to the economy of Jharkhand and India.
 
• It provides employment to thousands of workers and generates revenue for the state government through taxes and export earnings.
 
• The plant has also spurred the development of ancillary industries and infrastructure in the region.
 
 
 
• **History of Jharkhand:**
 
 
• Jharkhand was formed on **15 November 2000** as the 28th state of India.
 
• It was created from the southern part of **Bihar** to address socio-economic disparities and better cater to the tribal population.
 
• The state is rich in **mineral resources** like coal, iron ore, mica, and bauxite, which contribute to its industrial growth.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Bokaro Steel Plant Location:** The plant is located in the city of **Bokaro**, which is part of the Bokaro district in Jharkhand. It is strategically positioned near coal and iron ore mines, ensuring a steady supply of raw materials.
 
• **Industrial Development:** The establishment of the Bokaro Steel Plant has transformed the city into an industrial hub, attracting investments and fostering economic growth.
 
• **Global Collaboration:** Bokaro Steel Plant was established with the technical and financial assistance of the **former Soviet Union**, showcasing India's post-independence efforts to build industrial infrastructure with international collaboration.
 
• **Tourism and Education:** The city of Bokaro has also developed into an educational and cultural hub, with institutions like the **Chinmaya Vidyalaya** and **Delhi Public School**, and attracts visitors for its natural and man-made attractions like **Jawaharlal Nehru Biological Park**.
